items.definition:
a hot green pepper
I added some sliced jalapenos to my nachos for extra spice.

knitted garments
The shop specializes in high-quality knitwear, including sweaters and scarves.

A small parrot, often kept as a pet.
The lovebirds chirped happily in their cage.

A type of pizza with tomato, mozzarella, and basil.
We ordered a classic Margherita pizza.

father or grandfather (informal)
My pappy always told me to work hard.

a braid of hair
The little girl wore her hair in two neat pigtails.

a container, often decorated, filled with candy and toys, broken as part of a celebration
The children eagerly waited to hit the piñata at the birthday party.

a small toothed whale, similar to a dolphin
We saw a pod of porpoises swimming gracefully near the boat.

a person who gives up easily or abandons a task
He's not a quitter; he'll keep trying until he succeeds.

the state of being sleepy
A feeling of sleepiness overcame him after the long journey.

a Mexican dish of seasoned meat wrapped in corn dough and steamed or baked
We had delicious tamales for dinner last night.

a region where a uniform standard time is observed
New York is in a different timezone than London.

a road or path passing under another road or railway
We drove through the underpass to avoid the traffic lights.

the act of watching or looking at something
The art gallery offers a private viewing of the new exhibition.

an act of waking up; a call to wake up
I set my alarm for a 6 AM wake-up.

a small, enclosed space
The children loved playing in the little cubby under the stairs.

A person who specializes in hygiene, especially dental hygiene
The dental hygienist cleaned my teeth thoroughly.
